paperTitleZh: 物理 全新模擬卷 — 卷二 選修 D 醫學物理學（結構題）

parts.label: a(i)
parts.questionTextZh:
一個體育館的大型 LED 顯示屏由許多發光點組成，相鄰兩點的中心相距 $10\ \text{mm}$。觀眾在距離屏幕 $L$ 處觀看（圖 2.4）。取可見光的波長為 $550\ \text{nm}$。
解釋為何即使眼睛沒有任何缺陷，也不能分辨兩個非常接近的光點。寫出瑞利判據。
parts.questionTextEn:
A large LED screen in a stadium consists of many light-emitting dots, with adjacent dot centres $10\ \text{mm}$ apart. A spectator watches from a distance $L$ from the screen (Figure 2.4). Take the wavelength of visible light as $550\ \text{nm}$.
Explain why, even with no defects, the eye cannot resolve two very close points of light. State the Rayleigh criterion.

parts.label: a(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 在強光下瞳孔收細。這會令眼睛的最小分辨角變大還是變小？解釋你的答案。
parts.questionTextEn: In bright light the pupil becomes smaller. Does this make the minimum angle of resolution of the eye larger or smaller? Explain your answer.

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextEn: Find the minimum angle of resolution of the eye.

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 觀眾最少要坐多遠，才不能再分辨屏幕上相鄰的發光點？
parts.questionTextEn: What is the least distance at which the spectator can no longer resolve adjacent dots on the screen?

parts.label: b(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 場館聲稱：「坐在距離屏幕 $25\ \text{m}$ 以外的觀眾，都只會看到平滑、看不出發光點的畫面。」評論這聲稱。
parts.questionTextEn: The stadium claims: "Spectators sitting more than $25\ \text{m}$ from the screen will see a smooth picture with no visible dots." Comment on this claim.
